## The Great Reshuffling Is Here

The World Economic Forum predicts that AI will displace 85 million jobs globally by 2030 while creating 97 million new ones. The net is positive, but the transition will be turbulent for companies that are not prepared.

### Jobs That Will Grow (Demand Increase by 2030)

| Job Category | Projected Growth | Why |
|---|---|---|
| AI/ML Engineers | +45% | Building and maintaining AI systems |
| Cybersecurity Analysts | +35% | AI creates new attack surfaces |
| Data Scientists | +30% | Interpreting AI outputs |
| Healthcare Workers | +28% | Aging populations, AI-augmented care |
| Green Energy Technicians | +40% | Energy transition acceleration |
| UX Designers | +25% | Human-AI interaction design |
| Ethics and Compliance Officers | +32% | AI governance requirements |

### Jobs That Will Shrink (Demand Decrease by 2030)

### Jobs That Will Transform (Same Title, Different Skills)

| Job Category | Current Focus | Future Focus |
|---|---|---|
| Marketing Manager | Campaign execution | AI-augmented strategy, prompt engineering |
| Financial Analyst | Spreadsheet modeling | AI model interpretation, scenario analysis |
| Software Developer | Writing code | Directing AI code generation, architecture |
| HR Manager | Process management | People analytics, AI tool orchestration |
| Sales Rep | Cold outreach | Relationship depth, complex negotiations |
| Project Manager | Task tracking | AI-assisted resource optimization |

### Implications for Hiring Strategy

- Hire for adaptability : The specific skills needed in 2030 will be different from today. Hire people who learn quickly.
- Invest in upskilling : It is cheaper to reskill existing employees than to replace them.
- Build AI literacy across all roles : Every employee needs basic AI fluency.
- Pipeline for emerging roles : Use subscription sourcing to build early pipelines for roles that will be in high demand.
- Redefine job descriptions quarterly : Static job descriptions will be obsolete. Build dynamic skills profiles instead.

### Workforce Planning Action Items

- Conduct a role-by-role AI impact assessment for your organization
- Identify employees at highest displacement risk and create reskilling paths
- Build hiring pipelines for AI-adjacent roles before competition intensifies
- Create internal AI literacy programs with structured learning paths
